expected: I also found an article by Anirudh Sudarshan and Anying Li's from June 2025 which describes making Cube 3D generation faster through profiling and avoiding repeated computation. Their broader point is that waiting for things to load and happen interrupts a creator's ability to experiment. I will use that observation to connect Roblox's priorities to Coach Bob, where movement, visual targets and spoken feedback form one interaction that often needed to happen in real-time or near-real-time. It also supports my interest in measurable performance improvements. These two engineering articles let me explain why Roblox's work interests me through concrete examples, rather than relying on its popularity or love for the platform.
